aliases.name: Ladder Capital Finance LLC
aliases.notes: Form text on Part 8 items 1, 6, 10 of cp_filing_0003. Same creditor entity on three Trump debt rows.

notes: NYC-based commercial real estate mortgage lender; subsidiary of Ladder Capital Corp (NYSE: LADR). Lender on three Trump cp_filing_0003 Part 8 rows: item 1 (Trump Tower Commercial LLC mortgage, Over $50M, 4.200%), item 6 (Trump Plaza LLC mortgage, $5M-$25M, 3.850%), item 10 (TIHT Commercial LLC mortgage, $5M-$25M, 4.050%). Distinct from Ladder Capital Finance I LLC (Roman numeral I suffix, see cp_entity_0161).
